title: Ellicott's Commentary for English Readers
author: Charles John Ellicott, editor
description: Historical and linguistic commentary for English readers, edited by Charles John Ellicott and written by contributors across 64 biblical books. The digitized edition has no usable notes for Zephaniah or Zechariah and omits 14 additional chapters.
attribution: Ellicott's Commentary for English Readers — edited by Charles John Ellicott (1878-1905), public-domain edition
